{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Convert revenue from string to float, removing commas
# First, strip commas and convert to float
df['revenue'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Check for QA orders with revenue 999999.99
qa_orders = df[df['revenue'] == 999999.99]
print(f'Number of QA orders: {len(qa_orders)}')

# Check for refunded orders
refunded_orders = df[df['status'] == 'refunded']
print(f'Number of refunded orders: {len(refunded_orders)}')

# Check the value of revenue column
print(f'Unique revenue values: {df["revenue"].unique()[:10]}')"}
